purpose: NASA kaynaklarına dayalı ürün keşif kataloğu; indirilmiş bilim verisi veya analiz sonucu değildir.
latest_version_policy: Erişim anında canlı katalog ve granül kapsamı kontrol edilmeli. Özellikle EMIT yeniden işleme döneminde sürüm, gözlem tarihi ve AOI kapsamı birlikte doğrulanmalı.

datasets.name: NASADEM Merged DEM
datasets.nominal_grid: 1 arc second, approximately 30 m at equator
datasets.observation_period_note: Primarily SRTM, February 2000; not a 2026 terrain survey
datasets.caveat: Check NUM/source layers, vertical datum, vegetation/building effects and AOI changes.

datasets.name: ASTER GDEM
datasets.caveat: NASA/METI joint product; inspect artifacts and quality counts.

datasets.name: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2
datasets.latency_note: Typically 2-3 days, not a guarantee of clear observations
datasets.caveat: NASA processed product with Landsat and ESA Sentinel-2 inputs; use Fmask and scene metadata.

datasets.name: MODIS Terra daily land surface temperature
datasets.caveat: Clear-sky surface temperature; not 2 m air temperature or full diurnal extrema.

datasets.name: ECOSTRESS tiled land surface temperature and emissivity
datasets.caveat: ISS sampling; check cloud and water layers, observation time, uncertainty and geolocation.

datasets.name: EMIT estimated mineral identification and band depth and uncertainty
datasets.version: V2 announced 2026-10-19; resolve available collection and granules at access time
datasets.caveat: Targeted coverage, historical reprocessing ongoing in release notice; no verified AOI download in this research.

datasets.name: EMIT aggregated mineral spectral abundance
datasets.caveat: Static aggregate of historical observations; does not replace 60 m L2B at a micro-site.

datasets.name: NASA POWER
datasets.nominal_grid: meteorology 0.5 x 0.625 degrees, solar 1 x 1 degree
datasets.caveat: Coarse model/derived fields; not crater-scale microclimate.

datasets.name: GPM IMERG
datasets.version: V07 family; inspect specific run and granule version
datasets.caveat: Final run has about 3.5 month latency; label Early/Late/Final separately.

datasets.name: MERRA-2 aerosol diagnostics
datasets.caveat: Not a direct measurement of surface grain size.

datasets.name: NISAR L-band science products
datasets.release_note: Initial public release 2026-07-20; initial observation coverage from 2026-06-17
datasets.caveat: NASA-ISRO joint mission; verify availability, calibration status and product type.

datasets.name: PGDA LOLA South Pole DEM Mosaic
datasets.caveat: South polar stereographic, MOON_ME / DE421; pixel spacing is not uniform effective resolution.

datasets.name: PGDA adjusted LOLA large-area topography
datasets.caveat: Include ERR and EFFRES companion layers; several other grid spacings available.

datasets.name: PGDA shape-from-shading enhanced topography
datasets.caveat: Photometric reconstruction constrained by LOLA; not new direct laser measurements.

datasets.name: LROC NAC and WAC
datasets.nominal_grid: NAC 0.5 m scale, WAC 100 m scale in nominal primary mission geometry
datasets.caveat: Actual scale and geometry depend on observation; monthly releases differ from general LRO schedule.

datasets.name: Diviner
datasets.caveat: Derived maps have separate observation periods; mask missing tb=-9999 and inspect channel warnings.

datasets.name: LEND and Mini-RF
datasets.caveat: Not standalone proof of extractable water reserves or safe caves.

datasets.name: MOLA MEGDR
datasets.nominal_grid: up to 128 pixels per degree globally, approximately 463 m equatorial spacing
datasets.caveat: Historical altimetry, not new 2026 measurements; distinguish elevation, radius and areoid.

datasets.name: MRO CTX
datasets.caveat: Image resolution does not establish DEM resolution.

datasets.name: MRO HiRISE
datasets.caveat: Limited spatial coverage; inspect observation binning and label.

datasets.name: MRO CRISM
datasets.nominal_grid: targeted modes approximately 18 or 36 m per pixel
datasets.caveat: Instrument off since 2023-04-03; use archived products with mode and quality metadata.

datasets.name: THEMIS and TES thermal products
datasets.caveat: Day/night IR mosaic, temperature retrieval and thermal inertia are distinct products.

datasets.name: MRO SHARAD
datasets.version: per radargram and clutter simulation product
datasets.caveat: Check clutter simulations and detection limits.

datasets.name: SWIM synthesized ice mapping
datasets.caveat: NASA-managed/JPL project synthesis led by PSI; consistency is not reserve volume or mine yield.
